A second monitor can keep documents, research or video-call notes visible beside your main task, reducing constant window switching.

For a dual-display setup, check that your computer has two suitable ports and get the matching cables.

Similar-sized screens can make the view feel more consistent; adjust text and image sizes so they appear comparable on both.
